project: Murali Resort | Premium Resort & Convention Center
auditor: AI Website Design Auditor & Remediation Engine (Floto Workflow)
verificationScope: All 4 Canonical Routes across Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet Viewports

findings.title: Visible text not included in accessible name on hero scroll button
findings.verificationEvidence: Axe violation resolved (0 violations). Accessible name begins with visible text 'Scroll to explore — skip animation and view venue details'.

findings.title: Visible label mismatch in accessible name for spaces catalog link
findings.verificationEvidence: Axe violation resolved (0 violations). aria-label matches visible text prefix 'View All Spaces and resort facilities'.

findings.title: Insufficient color contrast on active navigation capsule link
findings.verificationEvidence: Axe color-contrast violation resolved. Active link rendered in #F5EBE0 on blurred capsule background with contrast > 6.2:1 (exceeding 4.5:1 requirement).

findings.title: Dead 'Celebrations' navigation link caused by preventDefault
findings.verificationEvidence: All preventDefault handlers removed. Nav link routes smoothly to /home#moments across header, mobile drawer, and footer.

findings.title: Desktop navigation links have tap/click target height below 24px
findings.verificationEvidence: Bounding box height measured at 40px with py-2 inline-flex styling, satisfying WCAG 2.5.8 minimum 24px.

findings.title: TextReveal component omits space characters in DOM text content
findings.verificationEvidence: DOM inspection confirms natural whitespace restored in textContent: 'See our spaces in person', 'Picture Your Event Here', 'The Journey Begins Here.'.

findings.title: Robotic jargon and developer implementation notes in Enquiry status screen
findings.verificationEvidence: Copy rewritten to warm, refined hospitality voice: 'Your enquiry has been prepared and is ready to send. To receive an immediate response and confirm available dates, connect directly with our reservation concierge via WhatsApp or phone:'. Button updated to 'Send via WhatsApp Concierge'.

findings.title: Inconsistent rectangular submit button in Enquiry form
findings.verificationEvidence: Submit button styled with rounded-full, aligning with Tier 1 solid button design token.

findings.title: Inactive desktop facilities panels exposed to screen readers
findings.verificationEvidence: aria-hidden={!isActive} verified in DOM. Only the active facility slide is visible to assistive technology.

findings.title: Interactive Leaflet marker touch target size below 24px
findings.verificationEvidence: Leaflet DivIcon configured with iconSize [48, 48] and [32, 32]. All interactive contact phone and email links upgraded to min-h-[32px] hit areas. 0 small targets detected on Contact.
